messages.text: 'We have our own strengths' – Gordon backs Tuchel’s DNA comments

metadata.summary: Anthony Gordon has backed Thomas Tuchel's view that England's players have an inbuilt inability to control matches with possession - and has urged the team to embrace the country's traditional strengths.
metadata.content: England vs Spain: Anthony Gordon backs Thomas Tuchel's 'DNA' comments about possession and calls on Three Lions to focus on their strengths | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content England vs Spain: Anthony Gordon backs Thomas Tuchel's 'DNA' comments about possession and calls on Three Lions to focus on their strengths Thomas Tuchel said control with possession is not in the DNA of England players after World Cup loss; Anthony Gordon agreed, explaining inbuilt ability for Spanish players; winger calls on England to focus on own strengths; Follow England vs Spain on Sky Sports website and App on Saturday Peter Smith Senior Football Journalist @psmithXI Thursday 24 September 2026 06:57, UK Image: Thomas Tuchel speaks with Anthony Gordon during the World Cup Anthony Gordon has backed Thomas Tuchel's view that England's players have an inbuilt inability to control matches with possession - and has urged the team to embrace the country's traditional strengths. Tuchel was criticised for England's defensive retreat after Gordon's goal gave them the lead against Argentina in the World Cup semi-finals, an approach which ultimately allowed their rivals to turn the match around in the final stages. Tuchel responded by hitting out at the 'DNA' of English players. "I think ball possession plays a crucial role; it's maybe not in our DNA like it is in Spanish DNA or in Argentinian-Brazilian DNA, to take the ball and control the game with the ball," he said. messages.text: Sedlacek wins first PDC Pro Tour title at Players Championship 30

metadata.summary: Karel Sedlacek secured his first PDC Pro Tour title at Players Championship 30, beating Scott Williams 8-7 despite a late scare as he closed in on victory.
metadata.content: Players Championship 30: Karel Sedlacek wins first PDC Pro Tour title as furious Scott Williams throws darts on the ground after loss | Darts News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Players Championship 30: Karel Sedlacek wins first PDC Pro Tour title as furious Scott Williams throws darts on the ground after loss Karel Sedlacek became the first player from the Czech Republic to win a PDC Pro Tour title, after he beat Scott Williams in the final of the Players Championship 30; watch the World Grand Prix from September 28, live on Sky Sports Wednesday 23 September 2026 20:01, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Scott Williams couldn't hide his frustration after losing a leg-leg decider against Karel Sedlacek (Credit: PDC) Karel Sedlacek secured his first PDC Pro Tour title at Players Championship 30, beating Scott Williams 8-7 despite a late scare as he closed in on victory. It was a thrilling encounter, with Sedlacek outlasting Williams' barrage of high scores, which included nine maximums, but both players struggled to close out the victory, with the Czech missing five match darts. Sedlacek would ultimately claim victory, becoming the first Czech player to win a PDC tour title. But after mounting an epic comeback, winning two of the final three legs, Williams cut a furious figure after the match, shaking hands with his opponent and the officials before throwing his darts onto the ground. Ronaldo - who turns 42 in February - will win his 234th cap against Wales in Lisbon on Thursday, with Portugal head coach Jorge Jesus confirming that the former Manchester United and Real Madrid will start the Nations League fixture.
